contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ CONSTANS PF AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Constans. Mint is Trier, AD340-341, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers, one standard. See RIC VIII, p.145, no.111. Obverse shows rosette diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads CONSTANS PF AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: M//TRScrescent.
